HOME SCIENCE MARCH — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Convenience Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Convenience Foods.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Convenience Foods.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Convenience Foods.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Convenience Foods.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Meals for Special Occasions? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Meals for Special Occasions.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Meals for Special Occasions.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Meals for Special Occasions.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Meals for Special Occasions.

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ventilation and Lighting? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ventilation and Lighting.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ventilation and Lighting.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Ventilation and Lighting.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ventilation and Lighting.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Yeast Products? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Yeast Products.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Yeast Products.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Yeast Products.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Yeast Products.

9. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

10. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

11. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Pastry Making? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Pastry Making.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Pastry Making.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Pastry Making.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Pastry Making.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Consumer Protection? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Consumer Protection.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Consumer Protection.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Consumer Protection.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.

15. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Special Treatment in Laundry Work? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Special Treatment in Laundry Work.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Clothing Construction Processes: Facings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Clothing Construction Processes: Collars 3.3 Clothing Construction Processes: Sl and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Clothing Construction Processes: Collars and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Clothing Construction Processes: Sleeves and Cuffs 3.4 Garment Design and Sketch and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Clothing Construction Processes: Sleeves and Cuffs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Garment Design and Sketching 3.5 Entrepreneurship in Clothing and Textiles Page  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
